rules.sourceBinding: Each hosted configuration or environment variant names its verifiedSourceSHA and retains matching evidence for that exact revision and toolchain. A previous report of 292 was incorrect. Published configuration-file pairs form the baseline. Source-defined environment variants need separate bindings and evidence before family completion. rules.missing: No audited implementation for this exact configuration. A partial or legacy port can still exist.
rules.implemented: A registered model-owned scenario and byte-identical upstream module/configuration reference exist. Semantic equivalence is not established.
rules.locallyChecked: Complete focused diagnostics have retained results for the recorded source SHA and matching hosted toolchain.
rules.hostedMatch: Retained hosted evidence for the recorded source SHA matches the upstream configuration, selected checks, checking mode, and stopping behavior. Exhaustive comparisons require complete initial states, states, and labeled edges. A check that stops on a decisive violation requires its complete verdict and valid witness, including any upstream shortest-path requirement. Unevaluated checks remain unevaluated. A completed check does not imply whole-graph equivalence.
rules.familyCompletion: Every required configuration is a hosted match. All module dispositions and legacy cleanup are complete. Partial coverage never counts.
rules.evidence: A successful job, count, digest, timeout, or truncated graph alone cannot establish a match. Historical evidence needs explicit review before credit.
rules.dsl: Each criterion needs complete acceptance evidence. Each new capability must name an upstream configuration and acceptance criteria.
rules.unconfiguredModules: No published configuration is not an exclusion. Unclassified modules require review before family completion.

executionStrategy.selectionRule: Audit the next three candidates, then implement one family at a time. Source inspection overrides the provisional wave order. Leave genuine blockers visible and incomplete, then select the next ready family. Prefer verified configurations unlocked relative to effort; finishing a nearly complete family breaks ties. A small shared fix may precede exhaustion of the ready queue when it unlocks several ready-to-finish configurations.
executionStrategy.evidenceRule: Bound hosted evidence work in progress to the current family and required shared/regression checks. Inspect failures before retrying. For timeouts identify the expensive phase first; do not repeat an unchanged expensive run. Existing in-flight runs may finish without cancellation. CoffeeCan capacity failures do not block implementation of DieHard.
executionStrategy.scopeRule: No Apalache, custom SMT backend, speculative architecture, invented bounds, weakened properties, or compatibility authoring paths. New DSL work must unblock a named upstream case. After corpus completion, explicitly close every remaining DSL acceptance criterion; corpus coverage alone does not prove all 19 criteria.
executionStrategy.completionRule: Scheduling labels and queue positions confer no evidence credit. Count only retained hosted configuration matches. Declare a family complete only after every applicable configuration and variant is verified, module dispositions are resolved, and legacy code is removed. The next deliverable is one fully verified family on a green hosted revision through the intended DSL and correct checking path.
